#### 1. Antley-Bixler syndrome with genital anomalies and disordered steroidogenesis  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.780)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:9208)

**Proposed mechanism:** POR (HGNC:9208) —DISRUPTS→ Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-70377); POR (HGNC:9208) —DISRUPTS→ Cholesterol biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-173503); Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-70377) —LEADS_TO→ Disordered steroidogenesis (HP:0003117); Cholesterol biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-173503) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital adrenal hyperplasia (HP:0000834); Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-70377) —LEADS_TO→ Ambiguous genitalia (HP:0000057).
